summary: Burning Rock Biotech filed a Form 6-K furnishing its second quarter 2026 earnings press release for the period ended June 30, 2026. Revenue fell 9.3% year-over-year to RMB134.7 million (US$19.9 million), gross profit declined 9.5% to RMB97.8 million, and gross margin held at 72.6%. Management cited order volatility in the first quarter and anticipated sequential recovery. Regulatory updates noted several NGS oncology kits entering NMPA CMDE priority review or innovative device special review. This is a routine foreign private issuer earnings filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or transaction mechanics apply.
